open_points.text: _confirmation_binding_digest: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] MUST answer the hexadecimal text of a collision-resistant cryptographic digest of one unambiguous serialisation of the action, then the target, then the version, then every field of inputs in the order its model declares them, lists in the order given and an absent value told apart from an empty one, so that equal arguments always give equal digests and different ones different digests; walking inputs it MUST tell a model from any other value by isinstance against the pydantic base model class, take its fields by iterating the model, which yields each field's name and value in their declared order, and take a tuple's elements in their order, never with hasattr, getattr, setattr or vars and never through __dict__ or model_dump.

open_points.question: The note must state the required canonical binding and digest behavior without prescribing field traversal, isinstance checks, iteration mechanics, or particular introspection operations.
